chapter_title: The 100 Gold Rings of Tuyet Nguyet

images.description: Four ancient gold rings with gemstones displayed vertically - ornate antique style with beaded borders and colored center stones

transcription.raw_text:
CHAPTER 2

THE 100 GOLD RINGS OF TUYET NGUYET

Don't Wing It

It usually takes me more than three weeks to prepare a good impromptu speech.
—MARK TWAIN

It's better to look ahead and prepare, than to look back and regret.
—JACKIE JOYNER-KERSEE

Boy, I took a lot of electives in college. I enjoyed learning about many topics. Too bad there was never a class offered called Life Preparation 101...
